assimilate.title: Regeneration
assimilate.description: Feed on a nearby creature to heal the symbiote.
first_tick_commands: execute as @e[distance=..8,sort=nearest,limit=1,type=!minecraft:player,type=!minecraft:item,type=!minecraft:experience_orb,type=!minecraft:arrow,type=!minecraft:area_effect_cloud,type=!minecraft:armor_stand] run tag @s add venom_feed_target
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] run data merge entity @s {NoAI:1b,NoGravity:1b}
execute if entity @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..9,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:regeneration 3 3 true
execute if entity @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..9,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:saturation 1 0 true
execute if entity @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..9,limit=1] run playsound minecraft:block.sculk_catalyst.bloom player @a ~ ~ ~ 0.8 0.7
commands: execute if entity @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:regeneration 1 3 true
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] at @p[tag=venom_feeding,sort=nearest,limit=1] anchored eyes run tp @s ^ ^1 ^0.25
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:invisibility 1 0 true
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:slowness 1 255 true
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:weakness 1 255 true
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,sort=nearest,limit=1] run data merge entity @s {NoAI:1b,NoGravity:1b}
last_tick_commands: execute if entity @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..12,limit=1] run effect give @s minecraft:saturation 1 0 true
execute as @e[tag=venom_feed_target,distance=..16,sort=nearest,limit=1] run data merge entity @s {NoAI:0b,NoGravity:0b}

enablevenomlocomotion.title: Locomotion
enablevenomlocomotion.description: Raise symbiote arms that carry you above the ground.
first_tick_commands: execute if score @s Venom.Locomotion matches 1 run tag @s add venom_locomotion_was_active
execute if entity @s[tag=venom_locomotion_was_active] run scoreboard players set @s Venom.Locomotion 0

enablevenomflight.title: Flight
enablevenomflight.description: Spread the symbiote wings and take to the air.

fendoffenemies.title: Fend Off Enemies
fendoffenemies.description: The symbiote lashes at nearby enemies on its own.

grabtentacle.title: Grab Tentacle
grabtentacle.description: Seize a target with a tendril and hold it in front of you.

grabtentaclepush.title: Push Away
grabtentaclepush.description: Push the held target further away.

venomhungerabilitycost.title: Symbiote Hunger Ability Cost
commands: execute if score @s Venom.SymbioteHunger matches 1.. run scoreboard players remove @s Venom.SymbioteHunger 1

symbiontpull.description: Tendrils seize nearby foes, lift them high and slam them into the ground.

symbiotestrike.title: Symbiote Strike
symbiotestrike.description: Ride the tendrils upward, then dash through everything ahead of you.

ragemode.title: Rage Mode
ragemode.description: Unleash the symbiote's fury for twenty seconds.

symbioteblast.title: Symbiote Blast

venombond3.description: The bond is complete. The symbiote holds nothing back.

knullsbond.description: Knull's legacy. The symbiote learns to carry you through the air.
